# 1 Enoch Chapter 37 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**37:1** The second vision that he saw — the vision of wisdom — which Enoch the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam saw.

**37:2** This is the beginning of the words of wisdom that I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those who dwell upon the dry ground: "Hear, O men of former times, and observe, you who come after, the words of the Holy One that I will speak before the Lord of Spirits."

**37:3** "It would have been better to declare these things to the men of former times, but even from those who come after we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom."

**37:4** "Until the present day, such wisdom has never been granted by the Lord of Spirits as I have received according to my understanding, in accordance with the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits, by whom the portion of eternal life has been given to me."

**37:5** "Now three parables were imparted to me, and I lifted up my voice and recounted them to those who dwell upon the dry ground."

---

*SOPHIA notes: Chapter 37 is the superscription to the Book of Parables. Consensus favors LOGOS's formal rendering for most verses. Key decision: "dry ground" (EMET/LOGOS) over "earth" (PNEUMA) to preserve the Ge'ez yābaśt. "Good pleasure" retained from EMET/LOGOS over PNEUMA's "will" — the term implies divine delight, not mere decision. See disagreement log for full details.*
